summary.text: Steve Weir was elected in November 2022 and began serving Andover, Bolton, Glastonbury, Hebron and Marlborough in the Connecticut House in January 2023; he is Ranking Member of the Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: Weir spent the early part of his life in Glastonbury and has lived in Hebron since 2000.
He founded American Integrity Restoration (now BluSky Restoration Contractors), and is an elected member of the Hebron Zoning Board of Appeals and chairman of the CT River Valley Chamber of Commerce.
